newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Chlor Alkai 96 net up 2.14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Chlor Alkai 96 net up 2.14 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures) Turnover 2,242.893 vs 2,365.161
Net asset per share 2.99 yuan vs 2.81 yuan
Earnings per share 0.244 yuan vs 0.239 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Chlor Alkai Chemical Co Ltd.
Note: The results were published in a company statement on Wednesday. The numbers are based on domestic accounting standards. Figures based on international accounting standards were not available.
The company's board of directors proposed one-for-10 bonus issue and a cash dividend of 0.06 yuan per share, pending approval of a shareholders meeting, the statement said.
Trading of its B shares will be suspended on Monday morning.
